question: Which missile-destroyer of the Indian Navy has been decommissioned after 36 years in May, 2019 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Ranjit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **INS Ranjit**

 
 
• **The Indian Navy’s frontline missile destroyer INS Ranjit decommissioned after 36 years of service. Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• It was **commissioned on September 15, 1983, with Captain Vishnu Bhagwat in command.**
 
• The decommissioning ceremony will be held at Visakhapatnam’s naval dockyard on 6 May 2019.
